page.title: 性質は能動形、前置詞はイメージで

analysis.summaryJa: このページは、他動詞でも製品や物の扱いやすさ・売れ方などの性質を述べるときは能動形を使えることと、受動表現の後ろの前置詞を日本語の「～によって」だけで決めず、行為者・状況・材料・向け先・理由・反応点という意味のイメージから選ぶことを扱う。
grammarPoints: 物の固有の性質や扱いやすさはopen easily、sell well、wash wellなどの能動形で表せる
byは行為者・直接原因・手段を示し、受動態の動作主を加えるときに使う
inは事故・作業・輸送など、出来事や状況の中で起きたことを示す
withは材料・内容物・道具など、対象に伴うものを示す
toは送り先・受け手・方向、forは評価の理由や用途を示す
atは特定の出来事や一点に対する驚き・苛立ちなどの反応を示す
visualEvidence: 製品試験台で扉・衣類・商品がOPEN、WASH、SELLの能動形のまま性能を示し、物の性質を表す用法を視覚化している
前置詞コンパスがBY、IN、WITH、TO、FOR、ATへ分岐し、日本語訳ではなく関係の種類で選ぶことを示している
BYの経路は行為者・手段、INは状況の内部、WITHは材料や付随物、TOは到達先へ向かう矢印として描かれている
FORは有名・評価される理由、ATは感情が向かう一点として対比されている
ミニ問題では事故を行為者ではなく出来事の中と捉え、inを選ぶ判断が示されている
commonTraps: 日本語で「開けられる」「洗える」と訳せるだけで受動態にし、性質を表す能動形を見落とす
受動態の後ろには常にbyを置くと思い込み、状況を表すinや材料を表すwithを使えない
known forの理由とknown toの認知する相手を混同する
送付先・受け手を示すtoを、行為者を示すbyと取り違える
事故そのものを意志ある行為者のようにbyで示し、in the accidentとの意味差を無視する
感情表現でat・by・withを文脈なしに交換できると考える

questions.prompt: The new packaging ------- easily without scissors.

choices.B: is opened

questions.translationJa: 新しい包装は、はさみを使わなくても簡単に開きます。
questions.explanationJa: 物の使いやすい性質を述べるときは、他動詞openを能動形opensで使えます。

questions.prompt: This lightweight uniform ------- well even after frequent use.

choices.B: washes

questions.translationJa: この軽量制服は、頻繁に使っても洗いやすいです。
questions.explanationJa: uniformそのものの洗濯特性を述べるため、受動態ではなくwashes wellを使います。

questions.prompt: The company's reusable bottle ------- especially well during the summer campaign.

choices.B: selling

questions.translationJa: その会社の再利用ボトルは夏のキャンペーン中、特によく売れます。
questions.explanationJa: 商品が売れやすい性質・実績はsell wellという能動形で自然に表せます。

questions.prompt: The exhibition hall was decorated ------- photographs taken by local artists.

choices.B: in

questions.translationJa: 展示ホールは地元の写真家が撮った写真で飾られていました。
questions.explanationJa: 装飾に用いた材料・内容物を示すためwithが適切です。

questions.prompt: Ms. Patel is widely known ------- her practical training methods.

questions.translationJa: パテルさんは実践的な研修方法で広く知られています。
questions.explanationJa: 有名である理由・特徴を示すbe known forの組み合わせです。

questions.prompt: Three packages were damaged ------- transit and had to be replaced.

questions.translationJa: 3個の荷物が輸送中に破損し、交換が必要になりました。
questions.explanationJa: transitという状況・過程の中で起きたことなのでin transitを使います。

questions.prompt: The registration fee was paid ------- bank transfer.

choices.B: in

questions.translationJa: 登録料は銀行振込で支払われました。
questions.explanationJa: 支払い手段を表す定型的なby bank transferが適切です。

questions.prompt: The client was surprised ------- the sudden change in delivery time.

choices.B: for

questions.translationJa: 顧客は配送時間の突然の変更に驚きました。
questions.explanationJa: 驚きが向かう一点・事実を示すbe surprised atが自然です。

questions.prompt: The updated access instructions were sent ------- every contract worker.

choices.B: by

questions.translationJa: 更新された入館案内はすべての契約社員へ送られました。
questions.explanationJa: 情報や物の向け先・受け手はtoで示します。

questions.prompt: Several outdoor events were canceled ------- the approaching typhoon.

choices.B: by

questions.translationJa: 接近する台風によって複数の屋外行事が中止されました。
questions.explanationJa: 中止を引き起こした原因を行為者のように示すためbyが適切です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing a product's operating quality.

choices.A: This cabinet door is close quietly.
choices.B: This cabinet door quietly is closed.

questions.translationJa: このキャビネットの扉は静かに閉まります。
questions.explanationJa: 扉の性質を述べるため、能動形closes＋副詞quietlyを使った文が正しいです。
questions.focus: 性質を述べる自動的な能動形

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about the office carpet.

choices.A: The carpet was covered by protective sheets material.
choices.B: The carpet covered in the workers.
choices.C: The carpet was covering to protective sheets.
choices.D: The carpet was covered with protective sheets.

questions.translationJa: カーペットは保護シートで覆われていました。
questions.explanationJa: 覆っている材料・物をwithで示すwas covered withが正しい形です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about an industry award.

choices.A: The designer is known for her energy-saving products.
choices.B: The designer is known by her energy-saving products.
choices.C: The designer is known to her energy-saving products.
choices.D: The designer knows for her energy-saving products.

questions.translationJa: そのデザイナーは省エネ製品で知られています。
questions.explanationJa: 評価される理由・業績はbe known forで表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about an accident report.

choices.A: No employees were injured by the loading-area accident situation.
choices.B: No employees were injured in the loading-area accident.
choices.C: No employees injured in the loading-area accident.
choices.D: No employees were injured to the loading-area accident.

questions.translationJa: 荷積み区域の事故で負傷した従業員はいませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: 事故は行為者ではなく出来事の状況なのでin the accidentが自然です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing a software feature.

choices.A: The new dashboard is loaded quickly as its general property.
choices.B: The new dashboard quickly loading on older computers.
choices.C: The new dashboard loads quickly on older computers.
choices.D: The new dashboard load quickly on older computers.

questions.translationJa: 新しいダッシュボードは古いパソコンでも素早く読み込まれます。
questions.explanationJa: 製品の性能・性質を表す能動形loadsと単数主語に合う-sが必要です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a company announcement.

choices.A: The decision was explained for all department heads.
choices.B: The decision explained to all department heads.
choices.C: The decision was explained at all department heads.
choices.D: The decision was explained to all department heads.

questions.translationJa: その決定はすべての部門長に説明されました。
questions.explanationJa: 説明の相手・向け先はtoで示し、was explained toが正しいです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a renovated lobby.

choices.A: The lobby was filled with natural light.
choices.B: The lobby was filled by natural light as an agent.
choices.C: The lobby filled to natural light.
choices.D: The lobby was filling for natural light.

questions.translationJa: ロビーは自然光で満たされていました。
questions.explanationJa: 満たしている内容物はbe filled withで表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a customer reaction.

choices.A: The customer was annoying at the repeated billing error.
choices.B: The customer was annoyed at the repeated billing error.
choices.C: The customer annoyed to the repeated billing error.
choices.D: The customer was annoyed for the repeated billing error person.

questions.translationJa: 顧客は繰り返される請求ミスにいら立ちました。
questions.explanationJa: 感情を受ける人にはannoyedを使い、反応の対象をatで示せます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly distinguishes an agent from a situation.

choices.A: The technician was injured in a falling panel during the inspection.
choices.B: The technician was injured with a falling panel during the inspection.
choices.C: The technician was injured by a falling panel during the inspection.
choices.D: The technician injured to a falling panel during the inspection.

questions.translationJa: 技術者は検査中、落下したパネルによって負傷しました。
questions.explanationJa: 具体的に作用したものはbyで行為者・直接原因として示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the most natural sentence about a report's readability.

choices.A: The revised report is read more smoothly as a property than the original.
choices.B: The revised report has reading more smoothly than the original.
choices.C: The revised report reads more smooth than the original.
choices.D: The revised report reads more smoothly than the original.

questions.translationJa: 改訂版の報告書は元の版より読みやすく流れが滑らかです。
questions.explanationJa: 文書の読みやすい性質はreads smoothlyと能動形で表し、動詞を修飾する副詞smoothlyを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “This suitcase rolls easily.”

choices.A: Someone is rolling this suitcase now.
choices.B: This suitcase is easy to roll.
choices.C: This suitcase was rolled by an employee.
choices.D: This suitcase must be carried rather than rolled.

questions.translationJa: このスーツケースは転がしやすいです。
questions.explanationJa: rolls easilyは物の扱いやすい性質を表し、is easy to rollと言い換えられます。
questions.focus: 性質の能動形と言い換え

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The lobby was crowded with conference guests.”

choices.B: The lobby was designed by conference guests.
choices.C: The conference guests waited outside the lobby.
choices.D: The lobby was famous for holding conferences.

questions.translationJa: 会議の参加者がロビーをいっぱいにしていました。
questions.explanationJa: crowded withは、その場所を満たしている人・物をwithで示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The consultant is respected for her honesty.”

choices.A: The consultant is respected by honesty as a person.
choices.B: The consultant sends her honesty to others.
choices.C: Her honesty was explained to the consultant.
choices.D: Her honesty is the reason the consultant is respected.

questions.translationJa: そのコンサルタントが尊敬される理由は誠実さです。
questions.explanationJa: forは尊敬される理由・根拠を示しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The documents were delivered to the legal team.”

choices.A: The legal team delivered itself to the documents.
choices.B: The documents were made by the legal team.
choices.C: The legal team received the documents.
choices.D: The documents were discussed for the legal team.

questions.translationJa: 法務チームがその書類を受け取りました。
questions.explanationJa: to the legal teamは移動の向け先・受け手を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The sample was examined with a digital microscope.”

choices.B: A digital microscope was used to examine the sample.
choices.C: The sample was located in a microscope company.
choices.D: The sample was famous for digital imaging.

questions.translationJa: デジタル顕微鏡を使って試料が検査されました。
questions.explanationJa: withは使用した道具を示し、was used to examineと対応します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Two passengers were hurt in the shuttle accident.”

choices.A: Two passengers suffered injuries during the shuttle accident.
choices.B: The accident intentionally hurt two passengers as an agent.
choices.C: The passengers were known for the shuttle accident.
choices.D: The passengers sent the accident to the driver.

questions.translationJa: 2人の乗客はシャトル事故の際に負傷しました。
questions.explanationJa: in the accidentは、負傷が起きた出来事・状況の中を表し、during the accidentと言い換えられます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The policy was approved by the board.”

choices.B: The policy was sent to the board but not approved.
choices.C: The board was filled with the policy.

questions.translationJa: 取締役会がその方針を承認しました。
questions.explanationJa: by the boardは受動文の行為者なので、能動文ではthe boardが主語になります。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The chair folds flat for storage.”

choices.A: The chair is being folded by a worker right now.
choices.B: The chair was damaged while in storage.
choices.C: The chair has a design that allows it to become flat easily.
choices.D: The chair must be stored without folding.

questions.translationJa: その椅子は収納時に平らに折りたためる設計です。
questions.explanationJa: folds flatは誰かの行為よりも製品の構造的性質を述べています。
questions.focus: 能動形による製品特性

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The hallway was lined with display cases.”

choices.A: Workers formed the hallway by using display cases as agents.
choices.B: Display cases stood along both sides of the hallway.
choices.C: The hallway was sent to the display cases.
choices.D: The display cases were known for the hallway.

questions.translationJa: 廊下の両側には展示ケースが並んでいました。
questions.explanationJa: lined withは、並んでいる物・構成要素をwithで示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The audience was shocked at the cancellation.”

choices.A: The cancellation caused the audience to feel shocked.
choices.B: The audience canceled the event because it was shocking.
choices.C: The cancellation was shocked by the audience.
choices.D: The audience was famous for canceling events.

questions.translationJa: 中止の知らせが聴衆に衝撃を与えました。
questions.explanationJa: at the cancellationは感情が向かう事実・一点を示します。

questions.prompt:
Buyer: Is this folder difficult to use?
Sales clerk: No. The cover ------- smoothly, even when the folder is full.

choices.B: closing

questions.translationJa: 購入者「このファイルは使いにくいですか。」店員「いいえ。中身がいっぱいでも表紙は滑らかに閉まります。」
questions.explanationJa: 商品の操作特性を述べるため、単数主語に能動形closesを使います。

questions.prompt:
Reporter: Why is the chef receiving an award?
Organizer: She is recognized ------- her work in reducing food waste.

choices.B: in

questions.translationJa: 記者「なぜその料理長は表彰されるのですか。」主催者「食品廃棄削減への取り組みが評価されています。」
questions.explanationJa: 認められる理由・業績を示すbe recognized forが適切です。

questions.prompt:
Manager: Who caused the damage to the loading door?
Guard: It was struck ------- a delivery truck reversing into the bay.

choices.B: by

questions.translationJa: 部長「搬入口の扉を壊したのは誰ですか。」警備員「搬入区画へ後退してきた配送トラックがぶつかりました。」

questions.prompt:

choices.B: by

questions.translationJa: 宿泊客「入口付近の床が滑りやすいのはなぜですか。」係員「来館者が持ち込んだ雨水で覆われています。」
questions.explanationJa: 表面を覆っている物質はcovered withで表します。

choices.B: to

questions.explanationJa: incidentはけがが発生した状況なのでinを使います。

choices.B: for

questions.translationJa: 顧客「保証金はどのように送りましたか。」担当者「昨日、銀行送金で振り込みました。」
questions.explanationJa: 送金の方法・手段にはby bank wireが自然です。

questions.explanationJa: 情報の受け手・向け先をtoで表します。

questions.prompt:

questions.explanationJa: 製品の作動特性を述べるので能動形locksを用います。

Guide: It is famous ------- a collection of early industrial designs.

choices.B: to

questions.explanationJa: 名声の理由・特色を表すfamous forが適切です。
